post.title: How car dealers make money (it's not the car)
post.ig:
At one of America's biggest car dealers, new cars brought in just 13% of the gross profit.
AutoNation 2025: new cars were 49% of revenue but 13% of gross profit. Parts and service: 17% of revenue, 48% of gross profit. Finance and insurance: 5% of revenue, 30% of gross profit. Used cars: 28% and 9%.
For every $100 of gross profit, about $78 came from the service bay and the finance office.
Source: AutoNation FY2025 Form 10-K.
News and education, not financial advice.
